results.name: Original document/material grants independently gate replication; unauthorized and foreign mutations are denied
Availability, document archive and deletion flags atomically invalidate cached file descriptors
File attachment sink rechecks document/material ACL and drops replaced versions for all actors
Temporal material expiry runs through the real durable scheduled native function without a client rebuild
Committee appointment add/remove and temporal end revoke the actual document and material access context
Online content writes advance the offline revision; pending old commands cannot overwrite newer notes
Native identity disable/rebind clears old actor projections and grants only the authoritative replacement binding
One-minute repair removes stale operator-written identity authority without granting its expired view
Ordinary workspaces remain unaffected; deleted selected meetings remove projections and recurring scope
Oversized imported membership or meeting sets cannot roll back role and security revocations
Retired and foreign issuer memberships cannot block current actors or receive replicated snapshots
Feature-disabled deployments cannot issue download authority or accept offline commands

runtime: Native Convex transaction oracle using production exports and actual scheduled mutations
limits: Identity transport injected by convex-test; live production broker replication tested separately
Trusted internal identity disable/end-date writes exercise the same native writer hook without exposing an operator API
Workspace limits remain 50 memberships and 100 selected meeting aggregates
Direct admin-key database changes are repaired by the one-minute cron, not intercepted
